final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.death_state, ''), '(missing)') AS death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT h.player_id) AS hof_players FROM hall_of_fame AS h JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id WHERE h.inducted = 'Y' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.death_state, ''), '(missing)')), above_average AS (SELECT death_state, hof_players, AVG(hof_players) OVER () AS average_count FROM state_counts WHERE hof_players > (SELECT AVG(hof_players) FROM state_counts)) SELECT AVG(average_count) AS average_count, AVG(hof_players - average_count) AS average_amount_above FROM above_average
